# Lessor's Risk Insurance

> Specialized commercial insurance for property owners who lease commercial space to tenants — Lessor's Risk Only (LRO / LH-1), commercial property, premises general liability, property management E&O, boiler & machinery / equipment breakdown, umbrella / excess liability, commercial auto, and workers' compensation. A division of Contractors Choice Agency (founded 2005, licensed all 50 states, NPN 8608479). A-rated carriers, 15-minute quotes, 2-hour claims response.

Lessor's Risk Insurance helps commercial property owners and landlords get coverage that actually fits the building: true LRO at the LH-1 class code that covers tenant-caused fire and bodily injury, commercial property at replacement cost, equipment breakdown for the systems that fail (HVAC, elevators, boilers), and an umbrella for catastrophic tenant-caused losses. We shop A-rated specialty property markets and turn around the certificates and additional-insured endorsements your lenders and tenants require.

## Coverage lines
- [Lessor's Risk Only (LRO / LH-1)](https://lessorriskinsurance.com/services/lessors-risk): The core coverage for commercial landlords — tenant-caused bodily injury, property damage, and fire from tenant operations.
- [Commercial Property](https://lessorriskinsurance.com/services/commercial-property): The building itself — structure, roof, mechanical systems, and tenant improvements.
- [General Liability](https://lessorriskinsurance.com/services/general-liability): Premises liability for the owner/landlord — slips, falls, and third-party claims in common areas.
- [Property Management E&O](https://lessorriskinsurance.com/services/property-management-eando): Errors in managing, leasing, and maintenance.
- [Boiler & Machinery / Equipment Breakdown](https://lessorriskinsurance.com/services/boiler-machinery): HVAC, elevators, boilers, and electrical panels — the internal breakdown standard property excludes.
- [Umbrella / Excess Liability](https://lessorriskinsurance.com/services/umbrella-excess-liability): Layered limits to $10M+ above LRO, GL, and auto.
- [Commercial Auto](https://lessorriskinsurance.com/services/commercial-auto): Property management and maintenance vehicles.
- [Workers' Compensation](https://lessorriskinsurance.com/services/workers-compensation): Building employees and maintenance staff.
